name: Khazna AUH6 Masdar City
notes: Khazna official press release and G42 news confirm launch of hyperscale AI-ready AUH6 in Masdar City, Abu Dhabi with 31.8 MW IT load; Al Ittihad also highlights 31.8 MW capacity and solar integration via Masdar-EDF PV plant (second phase online late 2023). Capacity is official IT-load figure.

name: Khazna AUH4 Mafraq
notes: Khazna press release confirms AUH4 (Mafraq, Abu Dhabi) as a new hyperscale AI data centre alongside AUH8 and QAJ1; FM Middle East (2025-04-23) reports groundbreaking with expected completion Dec 2026. Public MW not disclosed in these sources.

name: Khazna AUH8 Masdar City
notes: Khazna press release confirms AUH8 (Masdar City, Abu Dhabi) as new hyperscale AI data centre; FM Middle East (2025-04-23) reports groundbreaking with expected completion Aug 2026. Public MW not disclosed in these sources.

name: Equinix AD1 Abu Dhabi IBX (Masdar City)
notes: Equinix official AD1 page lists its Abu Dhabi IBX in Masdar City; original 2012 announcement described AD-IX/AD1 as the first carrier-neutral data centre in the Middle East. Re-verified from first-round lead; no public MW capacity on official pages.

name: Pure Data Centres Abu Dhabi (Yas Island)
notes: Pure DC location page plus operator news (2025-03-11) confirm the Abu Dhabi/Yas Island data centre with JLL appointed as FM operator; DCD reported the 4 MW first phase launched in 2024 with later planning filings for a second 48 MW facility on Yas Island. Capacity field records the operational first phase.

name: Gulf Data Hub KIZAD campus
notes: datacenterHawk lists GDH KIZAD Campus under construction at 16,000 kW in Khalifa Industrial Zone; DCD reported groundbreaking; a Meinhardt profile describes a two-building hyperscale project at KIZAD at 22 MW per building (originally 16 MW). Naming varies between KIZAD and ICAD1; location at industrial-zone level, mapped to Abu Dhabi Municipality.

name: du KIZAD Abu Dhabi data center
notes: Baxtel news reports du opened two data centres - KIZAD Abu Dhabi and DSO Dubai. Directory/news-source only; not yet re-verified against du.ae official facility page. No public MW capacity.

name: Khazna AAN2 Al Ain
notes: Directory listings (Data Center Map: 4.0 MW, Data Center Planet) record Khazna AAN2 in Al Ain as operational. No current Khazna official facility page found exposing the site; C-grade directory evidence only.

name: Etisalat Al Ain Data Center
notes: DCD reported Etisalat's UAE data-centre builds including Al Ain; Cloudscene facility sheet confirms 'Al Ain Data Centre' located in Etisalat's headquarters for the Abu Dhabi Eastern Region (Al Mutaw'ah). Telecom/operator facility with colocation services; no public MW capacity.

name: Stargate UAE / UAE-US Global AI Campus
developer: G42, OpenAI, Oracle, NVIDIA, Cisco, SoftBank and partners
notes: G42 official announcement: 1 GW Stargate cluster as first phase of a 5 GW UAE-US AI Campus in Abu Dhabi. Division mapping is uncertain: Data Center Map places the project on Hameem Road (Al Dhafra region) while dcpulse (2025-12-23) reports construction-phase launch in KEZAD. Mapped to Al Dhafra per Hameem Road lead with low mapping confidence; capacity 1000 MW records the first-phase Stargate cluster, campus build-out is 5 GW.

name: Khazna QAJ1 Ajman
notes: Khazna official groundbreaking release for QAJ1 in Ajman - described as the region's first AI-optimized data centre designed for 100 MW (20 data halls at 5 MW IT each); DCD and MEED (Laing O'Rourke construction start, Oct 2024) corroborate. Powered via Etihad Water and Electricity per DCD reporting.

Negative sweep: 'Manama' Ajman data center/data centre/datacenter searched in English and Arabic variants; results refer to Bahrain's Manama or Ajman-city Khazna QAJ1 only. No verified public data-centre facility or project in Ajman - Manama.
Negative sweep: Masfut data center/data centre/datacenter (English and Arabic) found no verified public data-centre facility or project; only generic/irrelevant results.

Negative sweep for Deira/old Dubai and port/creek-side localities: telecom exchange and cloud-service references only; no verified physical colocation, hyperscale or server-farm project confidently placeable in Dubai Sector 1.

name: Dubai Airports Modular Data Centre Complex (DXB)
notes: Huawei official press (2017-10 first modular deployment at DXB; 2018-03 double Tier III MDCC) confirms the Dubai Airports modular data centre complex - a mirrored Tier III pair at Dubai International, the first of its kind. DXB/Al Garhoud siting maps to Sector 2. No public MW capacity.

name: Khazna DXB2 Dubai Design District
notes: Khazna/Dubai Internet City 2022 announcement launched DXB2 (Dubai Design District) and DXB3; Baxtel notes DXB2 began operations in Q3 2023; Data Center Map lists 21.45 MW. Central Dubai/d3 siting maps to Sector 3.

name: Moro Hub Dubai Marina data center
notes: DCD reported launch of the 8.8 MW Dubai Marina data centre (Feb 2022) and its Uptime Tier III certification; Baxtel confirms the facility listing. Dubai Marina maps to Sector 3.

name: Etisalat 71 Umm Hurair data center
notes: Directory listings record an Etisalat facility at 71 Umm Hurair, central Dubai, offering colocation/connectivity. Umm Hurair maps to Sector 3; directory-only evidence, no public MW capacity.
Negative sweep for Ras Al Khor, Nad Al Hammar, Al Warqaa, Creek areas: real-estate, transport and generic references only; no verified physical data-centre project or facility in Dubai Sector 4.

name: Khazna DXB3 Ibn Battuta (Jebel Ali)
notes: PeeringDB facility 15227 lists Khazna Data Center Ibn Battuta - DXB3 at Jebel Ali, Dubai; Baxtel names Khazna DXB3 as the largest Dubai data centre at 22 MW; LinkedIn reports Tier III certification of DXB3 PODs 2-4. Existence strong, capacity B/C. Jebel Ali/Ibn Battuta maps to Sector 5.

name: Khazna DXB8 Ibn Battuta (Jebel Ali)
notes: Directory/marketplace listing (inflect) records Khazna Data Center Ibn Battuta - DXB 8 at Sheikh Zayed Road, Jebel Ali with colocation/DIA/bare-metal services. Directory-only evidence; no public MW capacity.

name: Etisalat Data Center Jebel Ali
notes: Map/business-directory listing for Etisalat Data Center Jebel Ali (Jabal Ali 1). Weak lead only; no official page or capacity found. Jebel Ali maps to Sector 5.

name: Gulf Data Hub Dubai Silicon Oasis campus
notes: S&P Global (2025-10) reports GDH operating data centres in Dubai Silicon Oasis since 2014; Data Centre Magazine/Vertiv describe three operational facilities at DSO with two more in planning/construction. Tier III carrier-neutral colocation. Campus mapped to Sector 6; no single public IT-MW figure.

name: Gulf Data Hub DSO 16 MW expansion
notes: Vertiv collaboration coverage (dayofdubai, MEP Middle East) describes a 16 MW data centre being deployed at Dubai Silicon Oasis alongside two new planned buildings next to three operational ones. Construction/planning status per trade press; Sector 6.

name: Equinix Dubai DX1/DX2/DX3 (IMPZ)
notes: Equinix official Dubai page lists three IBX campuses (DX1, DX2, DX3) plus UAE-IX by DE-CIX; PeeringDB facility 14653 places DX3 at International Media Production Zone (IMPZ). IMPZ/Dubai Production City maps to Sector 6. No public MW per campus on official page.

name: VOLT UAE / DIEZ DSO AI-ready data centre
developer: VOLT UAE (JV with DIEZ, Schneider Electric)
notes: DIEZ official site and trade press report the DIEZ-VOLT UAE joint venture to develop AI-ready data centres in Dubai Silicon Oasis with Schneider Electric; Data Center Map lists 'Volt Dubai' as a 29 MW AI-focused project at DSO. Status planned/announced - no groundbreaking found yet. Sector 6.
Negative sweep for inland/residential Sector 7 localities (Al Qusais, Al Twar, Al Awir, Mirdif and variants): no data-centre project or facility found; only residential/real-estate results.

name: Moro Hub Warsan Green Data Centre
notes: DEWA/Zawya press release (2026) records official construction-progress review of the first phase of Moro Hub's solar-powered Green Data Centre in Warsan; dcpostmea (2026-01) confirms first-phase construction; DEWA approved a second phase taking the Warsan campus beyond 100 MW with a 2026 launch scheduled. Capacity 100 MW is the campus-level figure; phase 1 under construction. Warsan maps to Sector 8.
